buildContext.contract: Local WebUSB chooser/granted-device connection, exclusive ownership and release; no streaming, decoding or audio claims.
buildContext.build: locked Vite production; hardware drivers and existing source/rate/profile guards

index.html.reason: Only the installable-app manifest link was added; no WebUSB policy, script entry, context or connection option changed.

src/App.tsx.reason: Connection chooser/granted-device handlers, native options and connection controls are unchanged. Changes add decoder modes, audio review and passive presentation; target connection smoke checks retained guards and startup.

src/radio/receiverController.ts.reason: Connection generation, granted-device, connectDevice, cleanup and ownership logic is unchanged. Changes add text-modem events and fields in receiving/tuning snapshots, outside access (mode normalized OFF).

src/radio/receiverConfig.ts.reason: Existing mode/source/rate validation is unchanged; additions register text modes and their settings. Access does not claim decoding, sample-rate processing or audio output.

src/radio/types.ts.reason: Only optional TextModemSettings type/metadata fields added; no runtime or source identity/USB interface changes.

src/radio/liveReceiverPipeline.ts.reason: USB access does not consume the receiving pipeline. Changes concern text decoding and audio archive output; target startup/permission and ownership tests check integration. No streaming evidence is reused.

src/radio/iqRecording.ts.reason: Changes only retain optional text-modem metadata on recording export/import, not connection ownership or permission.

src/radio/bladerfBackend.ts.reason: Connect/granted-device, chooser, native transport, identity, setup and release paths are unchanged. Changed code adds optional text-modem metadata and preparation during reception/retuning, outside access.

src/radio/hackrfBackend.ts.reason: Connect/granted-device, chooser, native transport, identity, setup and release paths are unchanged. Changed code adds optional text-modem metadata and preparation during reception/retuning, outside access.

src/radio/rtlSdrBackend.ts.reason: USB chooser, provider acquisition, native requests, exclusive ownership and release behavior are unchanged. configureConnectedSource adds only optional textModem return metadata; other changes prepare text modes during reception/retune. No processing claim is reused.

src/radio/usrpB205Backend.ts.reason: Connect/granted-device, chooser, native transport, identity, setup and release paths are unchanged. Changed code adds optional text-modem metadata and preparation during reception/retuning, outside access.
